b'# tinydl

A simple command line tool to download a URL.

## Command line interface

```
tinydl [OPTIONS] URL
```

### Arguments

- `URL`: what to download

### Options

- `-o`, `--output FILE`: file to write (default: stdout)
- `-q`, `--quiet`: no progress output
'
